name: Jezer
overview: Jezer was a male member of the tribe of Naphtali, identified specifically as a son of Naphtali. He is listed among the sons of Israel who journeyed to Egypt, marking him as part of the foundational genealogy of the Israelite people. His descendants are known as the Jezerites, a clan within the tribe of Naphtali.
namesAndTitles: The name Jezer means 'formed' or 'fashioned,' reflecting the Hebrew root of the proper name. This meaning may subtly point to God's sovereign role in shaping His people, though the name itself was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jezer as a son of Naphtali, situating him within the tribal lineage descending from Jacob (Israel). Beyond this, no additional family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jezer's significance lies in his place within the tribe of Naphtali and as part of the larger family of Israel that migrated to Egypt, a key event in God's providential plan to preserve and multiply His covenant people. The mention of the Jezerites in the census of Israel further attests to the enduring legacy of his lineage within the nation.
